one_liner: Workspace for docs and databases with a public REST API (pages, databases, blocks, comments, users, files) on the free plan, using tokens or OAuth.
notes: Auth: internal connection API tokens and personal access tokens are static tokens the user creates (api_key). OAuth integrations and public integrations use OAuth 2.0 (oauth2). The docs say you can start OAuth as soon as client credentials and a redirect URI are set, and that Marketplace submission or review is not required. So there is no app-review gate, and the verdict is ready, not ready_with_review. Access: the API works on Free workspaces. The block-limit doc covers Free workspaces using the API, and the PAT policy table has a Free row. One catch: Free workspaces with more than one member hit a 1,000-block lifetime limit on some API writes. MCP is official: a hosted remote server at mcp.notion.com/mcp, documented on developers.notion.com (makenotion/notion-mcp-server also exists on GitHub). The docs now say 'connections' where they used to say 'integrations'. api_style evidence: the reference intro describes HTTPS + JSON resource endpoints but never uses the word REST.

evidence.quote: use a static credential called an internal connection API token
There is no OAuth flow and no page picker.
Paid workspaces and single-member Free workspaces have unlimited blocks.
Marketplace submission or review is not required.
